title: Find your way around
description: A quick guide to searching lessons, choosing a topic, and finding a useful starting point.

sections.title: Choose a topic that fits your goal
sections.body: Use Learn AI for the foundations, AI at work for practical workflows, Careers for learning and job questions, and AI for your role for profession-specific examples. You can read in any order. If you are new to the topic, begin with AI, without the overwhelm and Your first steps into AI.
bullets: Every guide is available without an account.
Each topic page groups related articles in one place.

sections.title: Search in your own words
sections.body: Use the search page to look for a topic, task, or question. Search checks guide titles, descriptions, and lesson text in your browser. Try a shorter phrase if your first search is too specific. Topic filters help narrow the results without hiding the rest of the library permanently.
bullets: Try prompts, privacy, job security, or spreadsheets.
Clear the search field to return to all guides.

sections.title: Use the next useful step
sections.body: Article contents help you move between sections. Examples show the idea in context, and practice tasks let you try it yourself. Related lessons and quizzes offer a next step. You do not need to finish every article to benefit from one useful improvement to your workflow.
bullets: Use the breadcrumb links to return to a topic.
Bookmark a page in your browser if you want to revisit it.

example.title: A good starting route
example.text: Read the AI basics lesson, try one prompting exercise, then take the free AI basics quiz. Use the explanations to decide which lesson to revisit.

exercise: Search for a task you do regularly and find one guide with an exercise you can try using fictional information.

faq.question: Do I need an account?
faq.answer: No. The guides and quizzes on this learning center are available without an account. The main ai-skills.work product may have separate requirements.

faq.question: Does my search go to an AI service?
faq.answer: No. The learning center searches its static guide index in your browser.
